# Logic & Gate

> Logic & Gate is an independent video game studio from Bangladesh that designs, builds and publishes games for Android. It is a sole proprietorship founded on 16 April 2026 by Solayman Islam Ruman (Founder & CEO). Its horror games Dreadhush and Duskthorn are out now on Google Play. Its next game, Lalitar Cha: Last Order (ললিতার চা), is in development.

- Legal name: Logic & Gate (sole proprietorship)
- Registered address: South Bhitabaria, Bhandaria, Pirojpur, Barisal Division 8550, Bangladesh
- D-U-N-S Number: 732236869 (Dun & Bradstreet)
- Trade License: 2026927000012, issued by Bhitabaria Union Parishad, Bangladesh
- TIN Certificate: issued by the National Board of Revenue (NBR), Bangladesh
- Contact: support@logicandgate.com
- Google Play developer: Logic & Gate

## Games

- [Dreadhush: House of Silence](https://logicandgate.com/dreadhush.html): first-person survival horror for Android, out now on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicandgate.dreadhushproject)
- [Duskthorn: The Asylum](https://logicandgate.com/duskthorn.html): first-person horror for Android, out now on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicandgate.duskthorn)
- [Lalitar Cha: Last Order](https://logicandgate.com/lalitar-cha.html): first-person Bengali village horror game for Android, in development (details below)
- [Tanzanite Mining](https://logicandgate.com/tm.html): casual mobile mining simulation for Android, on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicandget.tanzanitemining)
- [Znite Run](https://logicandgate.com/znite.html): endless runner game for Android, on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicandgate.zniterun)

## Lalitar Cha: Last Order

Also written Lalitar Cha, ললিতার চা, or Lalita's Tea. Page: https://logicandgate.com/lalitar-cha.html

- What it is: a first-person Bengali village horror game for Android, made by Logic & Gate, a game studio from Bangladesh
- Status: in development. No release date yet, and not on Google Play yet
- Language: Bangla voices with English subtitles
- Platform: Android 10 or newer
- Premise: you play Montu, who runs a roadside tea stall called Lalita's Tea for four days in a Bengali village, in the month of Kartik
- Daily work: cycle to the stall along the rice fields, open the shutter, carry water from the pond behind the stall, make tea, serve villagers, wash the glasses, then go home
- Story: the first two days are ordinary. Day 3 is Bhoot Chaturdashi (ভূত চতুর্দশী) and Day 4 is Amavasya (অমাবস্যা), the moonless night. A woman begins visiting the stall, and on the last night she places one last order. The player gets one chance to serve it
- Folklore: draws on Bengali village beliefs about Bhoot Chaturdashi, Amavasya and the petni (পেত্নী), the ghost of a woman who died with a wish unfinished
